title: 社交战斗系统缺乏解释且反馈差
description: 社交战斗系统缺乏解释，行动反馈差，NPC和玩家经常说胡话。
evidence: it's a mesh of bad UI and poor action feedback to the player. First, why do you need to look at 3-4 different parts of the screen to see the outcome of your actions after every click? Second, why do stats jump like mad when you click on an option with a simple outcome? NPCs 80% of the time answer gibberish
